en: A colorized industrial-era postcard showing a large factory complex with multiple long brick workshops, sawtooth roofs, and several chimneys emitting no visible smoke. Rail tracks and wagons run through the yard among stacks of materials and machinery. The complex is surrounded by rocky ground and forested hills under a pastel sky. At the top is printed text in Swedish identifying the workshop complex in Trollhättan.
